Relevant qualification in plant operations, logistics, mechanical trades, administration or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.






Demonstrated experience coordinating construction plant and operators.






Practical knowledge of plant capabilities, operating requirements and maintenance coordination.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

Strong planning and resource-coordination skills.

Clear communication and practical problem-solving abilities.

About the Role


The Stores Assistant will receive, store, issue and track materials, tools and inventory to maintain accurate stock levels and ensure timely supply to projects and operations.

Receiving & Storage

Update inventory records and investigate discrepancies or shortages.

Prepare weekly and monthly stock reports.


Follow company stores procedures, HSE requirements and audit controls.


Perform other duties consistent with the role as directed by management.

Grade 12 certificate or higher qualification.

Experience handling building materials and tools.


Good knowledge of stock control, bin management and inventory records.


Ability to receive, check, record and issue materials accurately.


Experience conducting stock counts, stocktakes and reconciling shortages.


Understanding of FIFO stock rotation for materials such as cement, paint and chemicals.




Essential Skills & Competencies




High attention to detail and accuracy.


Good numeracy and communication skills.


Strong time-management and organisational abilities.


Ability to follow instructions and work under supervision.


Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.


Integrity and accountability when handling company stock and records.

 Reinhold Engineering and Group of Companies Limited
Department:
 Human Resources
Location:
 Head Office, Port Moresby

Reinhold Engineering and Group of Companies Limited is a nationally owned civil works and building construction company based in Port Moresby. As we continue to grow and strengthen our operations across Papua New Guinea, we are seeking a capable and experienced 
Recruitment & HR Administration Officer
 to support recruitment, employee records management and HR administration.


About the Role


The Recruitment & HR Administration Officer will coordinate end-to-end recruitment and maintain accurate, confidential and up-to-date employee records.


Reporting to the Human Resources Manager, the successful applicant will support timely recruitment and onboarding, maintain HR systems and documentation, and help ensure HR practices comply with applicable PNG labour requirements and company policies.


This role suits an organised and professional individual who can manage competing priorities in a busy construction and project-based environment.

Recruitment & Onboarding






Work with hiring managers to identify staffing needs and prepare job descriptions and advertisements.






Advertise vacancies through approved recruitment platforms and social media channels.

Maintain strict confidentiality of employee and candidate information.






Assist with HR audits, inspections and authorised information requests.






Prepare monthly reports covering headcount, recruitment progress, vacancies, new hires and turnover.

Degree in Human Resource Management or a related field.






Minimum of three years’ experience in recruitment and HR administration, preferably within construction or a similar industry.






Working knowledge of PNG employment legislation and labour requirements.

Essential Skills & Competencies

Excellent written and verbal communication.






High attention to detail and accuracy in record-keeping.

Company:

 Administration
Location:

Reinhold Engineering and Group of Companies Limited is a nationally owned civil works and building construction company based in Port Moresby. As we continue to grow and strengthen our operations across Papua New Guinea, we are seeking a capable and experienced 
Logistics Officer
 to coordinate deliveries and support our construction projects.


About the Role


The Logistics Officer will coordinate the movement of procured materials, tools, equipment and plant from suppliers to construction sites.


Reporting to the Finance & Administration Manager, the successful applicant will work closely with Procurement, Stores and project teams to ensure deliveries arrive on time, in full and at the agreed cost. The role requires strong organisation, accurate documentation and the ability to manage competing priorities in a busy construction environment.


Key Responsibilities


Procurement & Delivery Coordination




Coordinate supplier delivery schedules in line with Purchase Orders raised by Procurement.


Confirm delivery dates, quantities and transport arrangements before dispatch.


Follow up outstanding and delayed orders, and keep Procurement and project teams informed.


Coordinate checks of deliveries against Purchase Orders, invoices and delivery dockets, and resolve discrepancies before acceptance.


Track materials from supplier dispatch through to site delivery.

Coordinate shipping, freight, customs clearance and local transport for imported materials.


Work with Stores to ensure delivered materials are received, checked and recorded correctly.


Provide Goods Received Notes (GRNs), waybills and delivery dockets for stock recording.

Documentation, Cost Control & Reporting




Maintain accurate delivery records, waybills, transport invoices and GRNs.


Verify transport and freight invoices against agreed rates before submitting them for payment review.


Prepare weekly reports covering deliveries, delays, logistics costs and supplier performance.


Monitor transport expenses and identify practical opportunities to reduce costs without compromising safety or delivery requirements.




Safety & Compliance




Ensure logistics activities follow company WHS policies and applicable PNG transport requirements.


Coordinate safe loading, load restraint and transport arrangements.


Report accidents, damage, losses and delivery incidents promptly to the Finance & Administration Manager.

Diploma in Business Administration or a higher qualification.

Experience coordinating suppliers, transport providers and site deliveries.


Experience with freight forwarding, shipping and customs clearance is an advantage.




Essential Skills & Competencies




Strong planning, coordination and problem-solving skills.


Good knowledge of PNG supplier networks, roads, shipping and transport routes.


Good negotiation and cost-control skills.


High attention to detail and accuracy in documentation.


Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

Professional conduct, confidentiality and accountability.

Professional and respectful working environment.


Opportunity to strengthen logistics systems and support successful project delivery.

28944.description:
Job Type:
 
Permanent
 
About us 


K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate. 


We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.


About the role


Joining our operational services maintenance team, The Supervisor Electrical is responsible for the safe and effective coordination of personnel engaged in electrical maintenance across camp facilities, the diesel-powered power station and the surface high-voltage and low-voltage distribution network. The role is accountable for maintaining electrical asset availability and reliability, ensuring faults and defects are investigated and rectified in a timely manner, and maintaining compliance with site standards, statutory requirements and safe work practices.


Key Accountabilities




Accountable for the safe, compliant and effective delivery of electrical maintenance within the Operational Services area, including adherence to statutory, site and electrical safety requirements.


Accountable for the availability, reliability and maintainability of electrical assets supporting the diesel power station, HV/LV distribution network, camp facilities and associated surface infrastructure.


Own the electrical maintenance priorities, standards and performance for the area, ensuring critical defects, repeat failures and maintenance risks are identified, escalated and controlled.


Ensure the electrical workforce is appropriately supervised, competent, authorised and developed to safely perform the work assigned to them.


Maintain effective coordination with Planning, Operations, Engineering, Projects, Procurement, Contracts and other stakeholders so electrical work is aligned with operational priorities and site requirements.


Accountable for electrical maintenance cost control, annual maintenance schedules, budget input, contractor performance and appropriate use of labour, materials and external services.


Ensure maintenance performance, plant condition, significant defects, statutory issues and key risks are accurately reported to management, and support improvement and project activities that enhance asset performance.


Identify, monitor and escalate risks to generation, network reliability, and coordinate maintenance actions to minimise operational impact.


Direct the day-to-day activities of Electricians, Technician Electricians, Trade Assistants and Apprentices, including pre-start allocation, task clarification, field support and confirmation that assigned work is completed safely and to the required standard.


Review incoming electrical work requests and work orders, confirm scope and priority, and ensure sufficient technical detail is available before work is scheduled or released for execution.


Liaise with Maintenance Planners and Schedulers to build executable daily, weekly, shutdown and outage plans, confirming labour, parts, tooling, permits, isolations, access requirements and specialist support.


Monitor work-order progress during execution and ensure completed jobs are technically closed out with accurate labour, materials, failure information, test results, follow-up actions and equipment history.


Participate in backlog reviews and identify work requiring escalation because of safety, statutory, production, generation-capacity or network-reliability risk.


Coordinate electrical access, switching and isolation requirements with Operations and authorised HV personnel so maintenance and outage work can be performed without creating unacceptable network or operational risk.


Identify critical electrical spares required to support generation and distribution assets


Coordinate fault response and investigation for electrical trips, equipment failures and repeat defects, ensuring first-out information, operating conditions, inspection findings, test results, corrective actions and root-cause information are captured where applicable.


Act as HV Switching Supervisor where authorised, ensuring all switching, isolation, commissioning and restoration activities are planned, risk assessed and executed in accordance with site procedures.


Interface with Power Station Operations, Engineering, Projects, Procurement, Contracts, HSE and other relevant stakeholders to resolve maintenance constraints, technical issues, materials requirements and operational conflicts.


Coordinate electrical contractors, OEM representatives and specialist service providers while on site, including scope clarification, work-front readiness, quality verification and completion documentation.


Verify the quality of completed electrical work through field inspection, testing records and close-out review, and initiate corrective action where workmanship, compliance or documentation does not meet requirements.


Coach and develop electrical tradespersons through field mentoring, task observation, skills transfer and identification of competency, training and authorisation gaps.


Provide clear shift and roster handovers covering plant status, outstanding defects, work in progress, isolated equipment, critical backlog items, planned outages and matters requiring management attention.




About You 


To be considered for this role, it is essential that you have a NATTB Trade Certificate. You will also need to demonstrate experience in the installation and maintenance of power distribution systems, transformers, motor control centres and starters. In addition to this, you will have some or all the following.




Five (5) years’ experience working in a mining environment.


Must be a Registered Mine Electrician (or ability to obtain accreditation) and maintain the registration/authorisation required to perform electrical work at a mine site.


Must maintain a current electrician licence and any other electrical authorisations required by applicable government and site regulations.


High Voltage Awareness and Switching Certificate; current HV switching competency/authorisation is highly desirable.


Demonstrated experience in the installation, operation, maintenance and fault finding of electrical power distribution systems, including transformers, HV/LV switchgear, motor control centres, transfer systems, starters and associated protection and control equipment.


Previous hands-on supervisory or technical experience in a diesel-powered power station is essential, with practical knowledge of diesel generator operation, synchronising, load sharing, generator protection and station electrical systems.


Experience using CMMS systems (preferably Pronto)


Experience supervising planned and corrective maintenance in an operating industrial or mining environment, with a strong focus on equipment availability, reliability and safe execution.


Strong fault-finding capability across electrical plant and ancillary equipment, including general light and power circuits, motors, pumps, chillers, air-conditioning systems and camp/facilities equipment.


Ability to interpret electrical drawings, single-line diagrams, schematics, OEM manuals and technical specifications.


Experience in maintenance planning, work order management, contractor supervision, reporting, budgeting and continuous improvement activities.


Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to develop national employees, apprentices and trade assistants and coordinate work across multiple departments.




Life at K92  


K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.


Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.


At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.


In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster. 


THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP 





    	        
Apply

POSITION VACANCY: MECHANIC


Company:
 Reinhold Engineering and Group of Companies Limited
Department:
 Workshop
Location:
 Port Moresby / Assigned Project Site
Reporting to:
 Workshop Manager / Workshop Coordinator
Employment Type:
 Contract


Reinhold Engineering and Group of Companies Limited is a nationally owned civil works and building construction company based in Port Moresby. As we continue to grow and strengthen our operations across Papua New Guinea, we are seeking a capable and experienced 
Mechanic
 to support the maintenance and reliability of our vehicles, plant and equipment.


About the Role


The Mechanic will inspect, diagnose, service and repair company vehicles, plant and mechanical equipment to support safe and reliable operations.


Reporting to the Workshop Manager / Workshop Coordinator, the successful applicant will carry out scheduled maintenance, respond to breakdowns and maintain accurate repair records to minimise downtime and support project requirements.


Key Responsibilities


Mechanical Maintenance & Repairs




Inspect vehicles, plant and equipment to identify faults, wear and maintenance requirements.


Diagnose mechanical problems and carry out repairs within the scope of training and competency.


Perform scheduled servicing and preventive maintenance in accordance with manufacturer recommendations and company procedures.


Repair or replace defective components and check completed work before equipment is returned to service.


Respond to breakdowns and assist with on-site repairs as required.


Report major faults, recurring problems and repairs requiring specialist attention.




Parts, Tools & Coordination




Identify required spare parts, consumables and tools, and submit requests through approved procedures.


Coordinate with the Workshop Coordinator, Stores, Fleet, Drivers, Operators and project teams on repair requirements.


Record parts and materials used against the relevant job cards.


Maintain tools and workshop equipment in safe working condition.


Report parts shortages and other issues affecting repair completion.




Records, Reporting & Safety




Complete job cards, service records, inspection checklists and repair reports accurately.


Record outstanding defects and provide clear updates on repair progress.


Follow workshop safety procedures, including equipment isolation, safe lifting and appropriate PPE use.


Maintain clean and organised work areas and handle oils, fuels and waste responsibly.


Report hazards, incidents and unsafe equipment promptly.


Perform other duties consistent with the role as directed by the immediate manager.




Qualifications & Experience




Recognised trade qualification in Automotive Mechanics, Diesel Mechanics, Heavy Equipment Mechanics or a related field.


Demonstrated practical experience maintaining and repairing vehicles, plant or construction equipment.


Sound knowledge of mechanical systems, fault diagnosis and preventive maintenance.


Ability to read service manuals, technical instructions and maintenance schedules.


Experience completing job cards and maintenance records.


Willingness and ability to work at assigned project sites.


Experience with construction fleets and heavy equipment is an advantage.




Essential Skills & Competencies




Strong mechanical troubleshooting and practical problem-solving skills.


High attention to detail and commitment to quality repairs.


Ability to prioritise assigned work and meet agreed repair timelines.


Clear communication and accurate record-keeping.


Ability to work independently and contribute effectively to a workshop team.


Responsible use of tools, parts and company equipment.


Strong commitment to safety, reliability and accountability.




What We Offer




Competitive remuneration package.


Opportunity to contribute to a growing nationally owned company.


Professional and respectful working environment.


Opportunity to apply and develop mechanical skills across company fleet and plant operations.

Company:

Department:

Location:

Reporting to:
 HSE / Safety Manager
Employment Type:
 Contract


Reinhold Engineering and Group of Companies Limited is a nationally owned civil works and building construction company based in Port Moresby. As we continue to grow and strengthen our operations across Papua New Guinea, we are seeking a capable and experienced 
Site Safety Officer – Building Works
 to support safe operations across our building construction projects.


About the Role


The Site Safety Officer – Building Works will coordinate and monitor workplace health, safety and environmental requirements to ensure construction activities are carried out under approved HSE controls.


Reporting to the HSE / Safety Manager, the successful applicant will conduct site inspections, identify hazards, support safety training and follow up corrective actions in collaboration with project teams and subcontractors.


Key Responsibilities


Site Inspections & Hazard Management

Company:
 Reinhold Engineering and Group of Companies Limited
Department:
 Operations & Projects

 General Manager / Operations Manager

 Contract


Reinhold Engineering and Group of Companies Limited is a nationally owned civil works and building construction company based in Port Moresby. As we continue to grow and strengthen our operations across Papua New Guinea, we are seeking a capable and experienced 
Civil Superintendent
 to lead and coordinate civil construction activities.


About the Role


The Civil Superintendent will oversee daily civil construction operations, coordinating site teams, subcontractors, plant and materials to deliver works safely, efficiently and in accordance with approved drawings, specifications and construction programmes.


The successful applicant will supervise earthworks, road and pavement construction, drainage, concrete works and associated civil infrastructure, ensuring quality workmanship and effective use of resources.


Key Responsibilities


Site Leadership & Civil Construction Delivery




Plan and coordinate daily earthworks, subgrade preparation, pavement construction, compaction, drainage and concrete works.


Lead supervisors, foremen, operators, labourers and subcontractors to achieve production targets.


Review drawings, specifications, work programmes and site instructions with engineering and survey teams.


Coordinate survey set-out and verify that works follow required lines, levels, grades and dimensions.


Monitor plant utilisation, material deliveries and workforce requirements to minimise downtime.


Coordinate traffic management arrangements where required and maintain safe access around work areas.


Identify site constraints, delays and resource shortages, and escalate them promptly.




Quality, Safety & Compliance




Ensure civil works comply with approved specifications, construction methods and inspection requirements.


Coordinate with QA/QC personnel on material testing, compaction testing, concrete testing and inspections.


Monitor workmanship and ensure defects are corrected before subsequent work proceeds.


Enforce company HSE procedures and safe work practices around mobile plant, excavations and live traffic.


Report hazards, incidents and non-conformances, and follow up on corrective actions.




Coordination & Reporting




Coordinate with Engineering, Survey, Procurement, Fleet, Workshop, HSE and other supporting teams.


Maintain accurate daily records of production quantities, labour, plant usage, deliveries and site activities.


Verify completed works and supporting measurements before submission.


Attend site meetings and report progress, risks and required actions.


Perform other duties consistent with the role as directed by the immediate manager.




Qualifications & Experience




Relevant qualification in civil construction, engineering or a related discipline, or substantial equivalent practical experience.


Demonstrated experience as a Civil Superintendent or senior supervisor on civil infrastructure projects.


Strong practical knowledge of earthworks, pavement construction, drainage, compaction and concrete works.


Proven experience coordinating construction plant, site crews and subcontractors.


Experience monitoring production targets, quality requirements and construction schedules.




Essential Skills & Competencies




Strong leadership and workforce coordination skills.


Ability to interpret civil construction drawings, cross-sections, levels and specifications.


Excellent planning, resource allocation and problem-solving abilities.


Sound understanding of plant capabilities and civil construction sequencing.


Strong communication and reporting skills.

 Project Manager


Reinhold Engineering and Group of Companies Limited is a nationally owned civil works and building construction company based in Port Moresby. As we continue to grow and strengthen our operations across Papua New Guinea, we are seeking a capable and experienced 
QA Engineer
 to support quality assurance and quality control across our construction projects.


About the Role


The QA Engineer will coordinate quality inspections, testing and audits throughout project delivery, from material assessment through to final construction and handover.


The successful applicant will verify that materials, workmanship and construction processes meet approved drawings, specifications, applicable standards and client requirements. The role includes identifying deficiencies, coordinating corrective actions and maintaining accurate quality records.


Key Responsibilities


Quality Assurance & Inspections




Review project plans, drawings, specifications and construction methods for compliance with applicable requirements.


Conduct inspections of materials, workmanship and completed works to verify compliance with approved quality standards.


Coordinate and witness testing, record results and report non-conforming work or materials.


Recommend corrective and preventive actions, verify their implementation and escalate unresolved issues.


Support project teams in meeting quality objectives, delivery timelines and client requirements.




Documentation & Audits




Maintain quality documentation, inspection reports, test results and corrective action records.


Ensure quality records are controlled and retained in accordance with company procedures, contract requirements and applicable obligations.

Monitor quality performance and provide regular reports on defects, trends, risks and improvement actions.




Coordination & Continuous Improvement

Support quality awareness and training on construction procedures and best practices.


Identify quality-related risks and assist with mitigation measures.


Coordinate with relevant teams to verify applicable approvals and compliance documentation.


Implement lessons learned and recommend process improvements to reduce defects and rework.




Qualifications & Experience




Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering.


Minimum of three years’ progressive experience in civil engineering and construction, including relevant quality assurance and quality control responsibilities.


Membership of the Institution of Engineers PNG Inc. (IEPNG) is desirable but not essential.


Sound knowledge of quality assurance and quality control principles, construction standards and inspection procedures.


Proven experience using AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Magnet Office and Microsoft Project.


Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical reporting.




Essential Skills & Competencies




Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail.

Sound knowledge of construction methods, materials and applicable regulatory requirements.


Strong coordination, communication and stakeholder relationship skills.

Excellent organisational skills and accuracy in record-keeping.


Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant industry applications.


Commitment to integrity, accountability and continuous improvement.

Competitive remuneration package.

Seaside Developments Ltd T/A PNG Concrete Aggregates (a 100% nationally owned company) Serving Papua New Guinea for over 15 years, have become reliable business partners and suppliers to the construction industry nationwide.  We provide high quality products and services that conform to local and international standards. We have manufacturing and distribution capabilities in Port Moresby and Lae and are versatile to all customer requirements.


Position


We’re seeking to recruit a results-driven and professional 
Front End Loader 
for our Port Moresby office. The Front End Loader is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of a  Loader to load, transport, stockpile, and move materials while ensuring equipment is maintained in good working condition and all work is carried out in accordance with company safety procedures.

28919.description:
The Role


Reporting to the Exploration Manager, the incumbent will play a key role and lead all field teams, tasked with progressing our exploration and resource development targets from generative to resource stage. Woodlark deposit styles range from low to intermediate sulphidation with limited to data rich targets, hosted in volcanogenic terrain with complex lithologies and structural settings. This role will lead the field teams in exploration and is well suited to a field orientated senior Geologist with diverse experience in the exploration sector who wants to join a well-funded project. Possessing a real passion for exploration and a drive to find the next discovery your skills will lead and support the team to advance several exciting projects on Woodlark Island.


Safety is one of our core values at Woodlark Gold, and we expect employees to always act in a manner that seeks to enhance the safety culture and performance of our operation. Environmental stewardship and ethical conduct in exploration activities is expected.


This is a FIFO position working a roster of 4 weeks on, followed by 2 weeks off. Preferred Points of hire include Port Moresby, Lae, Mt. Hagen and Alotau.


About the Role:




Previous experience leading exploration teams and providing proficient geological support and ensuring surface exploration, trenching and drilling programs are completed efficiently and effectively.


Proven track record of successful exploration projects, including the discovery and delineation of mineral resources.


Strong technical proficiency in geological mapping, geochemistry, geophysics, and exposure to mining processes with sound interpretative skills.


Experience managing earthworks, trenching, RC and diamond drilling programs, from planning and execution to data analysis and reporting.


Working with geological and geochemical datasets to assist in interpretation of trenching and drilling results.


Providing timely, accurate and relevant drill reporting (daily, weekly, and monthly), and other internal and external parties as appropriate.


Acting for Exploration Manager and other duties as directed.




About you:




Bachelor of Science Degree in Geology.


Previous exploration experience in essential in epithermal gold and Porphyry Cu systems (desirable).


Minimum of 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in mineral exploration.


Strong leadership capacity in all aspects of exploration, from surface mapping and sampling, trenching, RC, and diamond drilling activities, QAQC implementation and control and rehabilitation.


Experience using Microsoft Office Suite and proficiency in relevant GIS (MapInfo/Discover, QGIS), digital data capture software (desirable) and 3D software. Ability to plan and manage drilling in 3D software (Micromine preferred).


Production of reports plans and sections (Micromine preferred), and assisting is presentations.


Good written and verbal communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.


Strong communicator, analytical, critical thinking skill and willingness to make a positive improvement.


Be self-driven and motivated, willing to mentor geologists and field technicians, contribute your ideas in a positive and proactive manner, share your skills and inspiring the team.


Valid manual Driver's Licence (Class 6) with recent driving experience well regarded.




The Offer


Role is offered on a Permanent basis.


This is an excellent opportunity to work with a dynamic and motivated team of industry professionals with experience in the demands and practices of exploration leading to mining project.


Woodlark Mining is prepared to offer an attractive remuneration package in line with experience.


Short-listing for this position commences immediately, however Woodlark reserves the right to commence processing applications prior to 31 October 2026.


If you are interested in applying for this position, please send your Resume & Cover Letter to: 
[email protected]
.


To be eligible for this role you must be a PNG National and previous applicants for this position need not re-apply.


If your do not hear from us in 20 workdays from the close off date, please consider your application unsuccessful.

28874.description:
Assistant Mill Manager – Palm Oil Mill


 


An opportunity to lead a safe, efficient and sustainable mill operations


 


About the Role


We are seeking an experienced and capable Assistant Mill Manager to support the Mill Manager in leading day-to-day palm oil mill operations. The position covers the full production process—from receipt of Fresh Fruit Bunches through extraction, storage and dispatch of Crude Palm Oil and Palm Kernel—as well as utilities, maintenance coordination and effluent treatment.


As deputy to the Mill Manager, you will provide hands-on operational leadership, maintain production and quality standards, strengthen safety and environmental performance, and support the development of mill employees.


 


Key Responsibilities




Supervise daily processing to achieve production, Oil Extraction Rate and Kernel Extraction Rate targets while minimising losses.


Monitor process parameters and ensure CPO and Palm Kernel meet required specifications.


Coordinate process, boiler, maintenance, workshop, laboratory, utilities and treatment plant activities.


Support preventive and corrective maintenance and reduce unplanned downtime.


Lead, coach and develop section heads, supervisors and operators.


Promote compliance with safety, environmental, quality and sustainability requirements.


Monitor operational costs, utilities, consumables and stock balances, and recommend improvements.


Act on behalf of the Mill Manager when required.




 


What You Will Bring




Strong practical knowledge of palm oil milling, production control and process optimisation.


Demonstrated ability to supervise multidisciplinary mill operations and coordinate maintenance activities.


Sound leadership, communication, reporting and problem-solving skills.


A strong commitment to safety, environmental compliance, quality and continuous improvement.


Ability to manage priorities, control costs and make sound operational decisions.




 


Academic Requirements




Diploma or degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical/Process or Agricultural Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline.


A bachelor’s degree and training or certification in palm oil milling, boiler operations, environmental management, ISO, RSPO, ISCC or HACCP will be advantageous.


A supervisory or management qualification will be highly regarded.




 


Skills and Experience Requirements




Five to eight years’ palm oil milling experience, including two to three years in supervision.


Practical knowledge of production, process optimisation, utilities, maintenance and quality control.


Proven ability to coordinate mill operations, manage breakdowns and improve equipment reliability.


Strong leadership, coaching, analytical, reporting and decision-making skills.


Working knowledge of HSE, environmental and sustainability requirements.


Ability to deputise for the Mill Manager and use Excel and production reporting systems.




 


Benefits


A competitive salary packages, including housing, utilities and other benefits will be offered for the role and will be discussed during the interview.


 


How to Apply


If you possess the necessary skills and experience for the Sustainability role, please send your expression of interest and CV to 
[email protected]

th
 October 2026. Please title your email as “Assistant Mill Manager Application”


 


Join Hargy Oil Palms Limited and be part of a forward-thinking team making a difference in the palm oil industry!

28834.description:
Comfortable in a CEO's office? Know what's moving in PNG's market before it hits the headlines?
  
 Our client, a major bank, needs a commercially savvy PNG national who can do more than manage relationships. They want someone who can walk into a CEO or CFO's office, talk confidently about where the market is heading, and bring solutions to the table for their key clients.
  
 You'll own a key Financial Institutions portfolio covering banks, super funds, insurers, non-bank lenders, development partners, multilateral agencies to government bodies. You'll set the direction for how the bank works with these clients in PNG, building stronger ties and growing revenue in a way that's sustainable and well-managed for risk.
  
 You'll become the person these clients call first. You'll understand what's happening in their industry, what they need over the short to medium term, and who across the bank can help them get there. You'll also be a visible face for the bank across PNG's financial community.
  
 
What you'll be doing
  
 
You'll join a small, high-performing Financial Institutions team, working closely with an experienced, hands-on Director who knows the market inside out and will back you to succeed.
 
 
Looking after a high-value portfolio of up to 50+ institutional clients and growing the bank's share of their business
 
Holding informed conversations about what's happening across your clients' industry
 
Supporting interbank relationships and new developments such as cross-border clearing
 
Bringing together lending, transaction banking, FX and markets solutions with the right specialists across the bank
 
Thinking through risk and benefit for both the client and the bank
 
Helping strengthen how PNG's financial system connects and moves money
 
Growing the portfolio while keeping it well-governed and compliant, including AML/CTF and sanctions
 
 
You're the person who...
 
 
Reads the market and can explain what it means for a client's business
 
Turns up to a meeting with ideas and solutions, not just questions
 
Is commercially savvy, quick on your feet and confident with senior leaders
 
Puts the client first and looks ahead to what they'll need next
 
Sees change as an opportunity, not a disruption
 
 
What you'll bring
 
 
A solid grasp of PNG's economy, its key sectors and how it's regulated
 
An understanding of risk exposure. First-line risk experience would be ideal
 
Knowledge of financial institutions and non-bank lenders, though this isn't essential
 
The ability to think strategically and follow through
 
A degree in business, finance, economics or similar
 
 
Banking experience is welcome but not essential.
 If you've built your career in insurance, finance, risk, development or another related field, we want to hear from you.
  
 If you're the person clients trust for a straight, smart conversation about their business, we'd like to talk to you.
 
Apply now
 or contact Kasey Smith at Peopleconnexion for a confidential discussion.





    	        
Apply

POSITION VACANCY: PROJECT ENGINEER


Company:
 Reinhold Engineering and Group of Companies Limited
Location:
 Port Moresby


Reinhold Engineering and Group of Companies Limited is a nationally owned civil works and building construction company based in Port Moresby. As we continue to grow and strengthen our operations across Papua New Guinea, we are seeking a capable and experienced 
Project Engineer
 to coordinate and oversee the technical delivery of our construction projects.


About the Role


The Project Engineer will oversee the day-to-day technical execution of construction and engineering projects. This includes translating approved engineering designs into practical site plans, managing resources and ensuring works comply with specifications, applicable codes and regulatory requirements.


The successful applicant will maintain project progress, resolve on-site technical challenges and coordinate effectively with project teams, subcontractors, suppliers and client representatives.

Manage and monitor project timelines, milestones and critical paths to ensure on-schedule delivery.


Supervise and coordinate subcontractors and direct labour, ensuring work complies with contract documents and quality standards.


Conduct regular site inspections to verify compliance with engineering specifications, applicable building codes and safety requirements.


Attend and contribute to design coordination meetings, client reviews and site progress meetings.


Communicate effectively with internal project teams, subcontractors, suppliers and client representatives.


Review and process technical submittals, shop drawings and requests for information (RFIs).


Implement and enforce site safety protocols and quality control procedures.


Provide practical technical guidance and problem-solving support to resolve construction and engineering issues.


Maintain accurate project documentation, including daily reports, progress photographs and as-built drawings.




Qualifications & Experience




Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Mechanical Engineering or a related field.


Three to five years of proven experience in a project engineering or assistant project management role within the construction or heavy industrial sector.


Demonstrated experience managing subcontractors and direct-hire workforces.




Key Competencies




Strong technical skills, including the ability to read and interpret complex engineering drawings, schematics and specifications.


Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with strong attention to detail.


Proficiency in project management software, such as Microsoft Project or Primavera, and Microsoft Office applications.


Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


Proven ability to lead, motivate and coordinate teams in a demanding project environment.


Sound understanding of applicable construction safety requirements and quality assurance and quality control processes.


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to address site challenges proactively.




What We Offer




Competitive remuneration package.

Professional and respectful working environment.

The Payroll Officer will be responsible for the accurate and timely processing of employee pay, calculating wages and salaries, benefits, tax deductions and superannuation contributions in compliance with regulatory requirements. Summary








Responsible for supervising and coordinating the activities of the construction site team, including subcontractors, to ensure that the construction project is completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the required quality standards.


Report to the Construction Site Manager and will work closely with other stakeholders, such as architects, engineers, and project managers.




Duties and Responsibilities








Supervise and coordinate the activities of the construction site team, including subcontractors, to ensure that the project is completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the required quality standards.


Review project plans and specifications and ensure that the work is carried out in accordance with these documents.


Ensure that all workers on the construction site comply with safety regulations, building codes, and other legal requirements.


Manage the procurement process, including purchasing and receiving materials, supplies, and equipment.


Monitor the progress of the construction project and ensure that it is progressing according to schedule and budget.


Report progress to the Construction Site Manager and other stakeholders and address any issues or concerns that arise.


Maintain accurate records of all construction site activities, including time sheets, material usage, and subcontractor invoices.


Provide guidance and support to the construction site team and subcontractors as needed.


Ensure that all work is completed to a high standard of quality, and that all defects are identified and remedied promptly.


Participate in site meetings and other project-related meetings as required.




Job Requirements








Bachelor's degree in construction management or related field preferred.


3-5 years of experience in construction supervision, with a proven track record of managing successful construction projects.


Strong knowledge of construction industry best practices, including safety regulations, building codes, and other legal requirements.


Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to motivate and manage a team of construction professionals.


Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve issues quickly and efficiently.


Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.


Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.


Ability to read and interpret blueprints, schematics, and other technical drawings.


Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.


Strong attention to detail and accuracy.




Others








The ability to stand, walk, and work on uneven terrain for extended periods.


The ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.


The ability to work in all weather conditions.


Height, confined space


From one site to another site. May require to travel to another city.

28766.description:
Summary






Own the Western kitchen: menu, consistency, team growth, and cost control.


Duties and Responsibilities




1. Culinary Leadership & Menu Development




Design, execute, and continuously improve cuisine menus
.


Develop seasonal specials, tasting and event catering menus aligned with current market trends and target demographics.


Create standardized recipe cards including precise ingredient weights, yield calculations, portion control guidelines, and step-by-step plating guides.


Ensure food quality, presentation standards, and flavor profiles remain consistently high during all service periods.




2. Kitchen Operations & Service Management




Oversee daily station setups (mise en place), service workflow, line management, and breakdown procedures.


Expedite orders during peak service hours to maintain fast ticket times, smooth communication with Front of House (FOH), and low table wait times.


Monitor inventory shelf-life rotation (FIFO) and daily prep lists to minimize waste and stockouts.


Oversee station equipment maintenance, ensuring routine checks, cleaning schedules, and repair logging are maintained.




3. Financial Management & Cost Control




Manage the kitchen budget to meet targeted food cost and labour cost percentage goals.


Manage inventory level by conducting weekly stock takes and implement corrective actions for stock losses or yield drops.


Monitor kitchen utility usage, operational supplies, and equipment lifespan to manage overhead expenses.




4. Team Leadership & Training




Conduct regular culinary skills training, knife skills workshops, food safety refreshers, and station cross-training.


Build weekly rosters based on sales forecasts, customer traffic trends, and labor budget constraints.


Foster a positive, respectful, and high-energy kitchen culture while resolving interpersonal conflicts and enforcing company policies.




5. Food Safety, Hygiene & Sanitation




Enforce total compliance with public health regulations, HACCP, and ISO/Food Handling safety standards.


Establish daily cleaning checklists, deep-cleaning routines, and hygiene audits for all preparation lines and storage areas.


Monitor cold-chain storage temperatures, walk-in chillers, freezer logs, and label/date systems for all raw and cooked inventory.


Ensure all back-of-house staff strictly adhere to personal grooming, uniform cleanliness, and hand-washing rules.








Job Requirements




Required Qualifications & Experience




Education:
 Diploma or Degree in Culinary Arts, Hospitality Management, or equivalent professional chef certifications.


Experience:
 Minimum 
5–7 years
 of culinary experience in high-volume Western restaurant   with at least 
2–3 years 
 in a Head Chef, Executive Sous Chef position.


Certifications:
 Valid Food Handler Certificate and Advanced HACCP / SERV Safe Manager certification.




Key Competencies & Technical Skills




Menu Engineering & Costing:
 In-depth understanding of food cost mechanics, recipe costing spreadsheets, and yield management.


POS & Kitchen Software:
 Hands-on experience with POS inventory modules, kitchen management software, and digital ticketing systems (KDS).


Leadership Under Pressure:
 Proven ability to stay calm, focused, and organized in high-stress, high-volume kitchen environments.


Communication:
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate dish concepts to FOH and delegate clearly to kitchen teams.




Work Environment & Physical Requirements




Ability to stand, walk, bend, and lift up to 25 kg (55 lbs.) throughout long shifts.


Flexibility to work nights, weekends, split shifts, and public holidays as required by restaurant operations.


Comfort working in environments with high heat, open flames, steam, and cold storage areas.








Others








Hours & Overtime as per PNG law.


Strict food safety and H&S compliance.


Training/succession of PNG staff; records maintained.


Reports to: Restaurant Manager.










 
To Apply
To apply for this job simply click on the blue "Apply" button below.  If you prefer to use email instead, please send your CV and other relevant documentation to

.  Please include the Job ID "
#28766
" in the email's subject to ensure your application is processed.

Summary






The Fleet Administrator coordinates and manages the company's day-to-day fleet operations. They are responsible for ensuring the maximum availability, efficiency of company's vehicles or equipments and in compliance to project requirements. This role requires a strong understanding of project scope, heavy equipment operations, site activities, and effective communication between operators, supervisors, and the workshop maintenance team.


Duties and Responsibilities






Fleet Operations & Administration


Maintain accurate records of fleet assets, equipment utilization, maintenance schedules, inspections, and repairs.


Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly fleet reports.


Track fuel consumption, equipment hours, vehicle mileage, downtime, and operational performance.


 


Project Coordination


Develop a clear understanding of project scope, schedules, and equipment requirements.


Monitor equipment availability and coordinate fleet deployment to support project activities and ensure operational continuity.

Coordinate repair requests, maintenance schedules, and equipment servicing activities.

Safety & Compliance

Promote safe equipment operation and maintenance practices.

28734.description:
HSEQ SUPERINTENDENT – PNG 


 


Quest Exploration Drilling (PNG) Ltd
 is a leading drilling services company with extensive experience supporting mining and exploration operations across Papua New Guinea. QED is committed to delivering safe, efficient, and high – quality drilling services to its clients, while maintaining strong operational standards and a focus on workforce capability, accountability, and performance.


 


Lead Safety. Strengthen Systems, Influence the Field!


We are seeking an experience and hands-on HSEQ Superintendent to join our HSEQ team in Lae.


 


This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and is confident managing a team of HSEQ professionals. This is a senior operational role responsible for supporting the implementation, monitoring and continuous improvement of QED’s HSEQ system across our PNG operations.  The successful candidate will provide practical HSEQ leadership and assurance to our projects, helping ensure risks are effectively controlled and QED, client, regulatory and ISO requirements are consistently applied.


 


Location
:  Lae, Morobe Province


Department
: HSEQ  


 


We are looking for someone who is comfortable both in the field and working with management, and who can turn HSEQ systems and requirements into practical actions that support safe and efficient drilling operations.


 


Key Responsibilities




Leading the day-to-day implementation of HSEQ policies, procedures, safe work instructions and project-specific requirements.


Conducting and facilitating risk assessments, field inspections, project entry reviews and Management of Change activities.


Leading and supporting incident and near-miss investigations, including root cause analysis and ICAM where required.


Ensuring corrective and preventative actions are followed through to verified close-out.


Providing visible field leadership through regular site visits, observations, coaching and engagement with supervisors and workforce.


Supervising, mentoring and supporting HSEQ Advisors and Officers across operational sites.


Supporting HSEQ training, inductions, toolbox meetings, emergency response exercise and permit-to-work requirements.


Monitoring HSEQ inspections, audits, non-conformances, performance indicators and emerging operational risk.


Supporting QED’s Integrated Management System and compliance with applicable ISO 45001, ISO 14001, and ISO 9001 requirements.


Preparing clear and timely HSEQ reports for management, clients and other stakeholders.


Liaising professionally with clients, contractors, service providers and regulatory authorities on operational HSEQ matters.




 


Skills & Experience required: 




Must have a minimum of 8-years practical HSEQ experience, including senior-site based HSEQ or supervisory experience.


Reliable, accountable and committed to producing accurate work.


Experience within a drilling, mining, exploration, oil & gas, heavy industry or another high-risk operational environment.


Demonstrated experience in incident investigation, risk management, audits, inspections, corrective actions and HSEQ reporting.


Strong working knowledge of practical risk-management tools including JHAs/JSEAs, permit-to-work and Management of Change.


Safety-conscious and committed to quality and compliance.


Calm under pressure and comfortable working across multiple projects.




 


Qualifications: 




A diploma or bachelor qualification in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Health, Applied Science or a related discipline, or equivalent recognized experience.


Relevant OHS/HSE certification.


Leadership and project management qualification.




 


Personal Attributes: 




Strong Leadership


Safety focused


Excellent Communication


Organised and Analytical


Results Driven


Adaptable to remote operations




 


Why join QED?


QED Offers the opportunity to work within a reputable and established drilling contractor supporting major operations across Papua New Guinea. This role is suited to an experienced HSEQ professional looking to contribute to a high-performing and safety-driven operational team.


 


How to apply?


Applications can be emailed to: 
[email protected]
 . Subject Line ‘
Application for “HSEQ Superintendent”
.  Note to combine all documents into a single PDF file when submitting.




Application Letter


Curriculum Vitae
 (must also include contact details for at least three (3) referees)


Copies of Relevant qualifications, licenses and supporting documents




 


Applications close on 30 November 2026. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.


 


Quest Exploration Drilling is an equal opportunity employer.


 


“WORK SAFE, HOME SAFE”

28729.description:
Provide objective challenge on credit proposals & exceptions
Oversee IFRS 9 ECL and present to Board committees
Lead & develop a team of five, growing technical skills & succession depth
A rare senior credit risk seat in PNG banking.
 Our client, a well-established PNG bank with a strong local presence, is looking for a Head of Credit Risk to lead independent second-line oversight, with direct reporting line to the Group CRO and regular Board committee exposure.
 
About the role
 
This role leads a team of five as the independent voice on credit risk across the bank, challenging lending proposals, restructures and exceptions while keeping a close eye on portfolio quality, concentrations and emerging risks. 
Responsibilities include overseeing IFRS 9 ECL and impairment review, shaping credit policy and stress testing, and presenting to management and Board committees, working closely with Lending, Finance and the Asset Management Unit.
 
Key responsibilities
 
 
Independent assessment and challenge of credit proposals, renewals and exceptions
 
Portfolio monitoring: arrears, NPLs, concentrations, collateral and early warning indicators
 
Oversight and challenge of IFRS 9 ECL assessments and provisioning
 
Credit policy, risk appetite and delegated authority reviews
 
Credit portfolio stress testing and forward-looking risk reporting
 
Independent review of watchlist, forbearance and recovery strategies
 
Leading, coaching and developing a team of five, including succession planning and technical training
 
 
About you
 
 
Bachelor's degree in Banking, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Commerce or similar
 
10+ years in banking, lending or credit risk, with strong credit assessment and portfolio risk experience
 
Proven senior management experience in a financial institution
 
Solid knowledge of commercial lending, security structures, impairment, problem loans and delegated authorities
 
Working knowledge of IFRS 9 ECL, portfolio analytics and regulatory reporting
 
Confident communicator who can present to committees and hold their ground with constructive challenge
 
Exposure to credit risk systems, stress testing and model governance
 
Experience in PNG or Pacific financial services regulatory environments
 
Postgraduate or professional qualification in banking, finance, credit or risk desirable
 
 
Why this role
 This is a genuine senior leadership position with direct access to the Group Chief Risk Officer and Board-level visibility. It carries real influence over how credit risk is managed across the bank. With no lending volume or revenue targets attached, you can focus on sound, independent judgement.
